sources: PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all on your account, so there is nothing separate to do for it. Work the roadmap stages in order and use this tracker to confirm nothing is left at 99%.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It cannot be missed: play the prologue through to the end and it pops during the closing scene. If it ever fails to appear, replay the mission from the progress menu.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. All chapter trophies are unmissable on a normal playthrough, so just follow the story markers; this one lands as the chapter's final cutscene ends.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 in the story. Unmissable: keep following the main path and it unlocks when the chapter closes, whatever order you do side content in.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 in the story. Unmissable. By now you should also start keeping a rotating manual save, which protects the few one-off moment trophies flagged in this guide.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 in the story. Unmissable. After this chapter the map and activity list are fully open, which is a good point to start Stage 2 of the roadmap alongside the story.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Before you start it, make a manual save: choice-based trophies later in the list are easiest to clean up from a save made here. The trophy pops after the ending sequence.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears on the map. It is a named story mission, so it cannot be skipped permanently; finish it at any point in the chapter where it is offered.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist story mission. Prepare with full armour and your best rifle before the start marker; the trophy unlocks when the heist wraps up, on any difficulty.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A named story mission on the main path; it unlocks on completion and cannot be missed while progressing the story.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Part of the main story path, so simply play through it; the trophy is awarded at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the airport-authority story mission. Watch for the 'Catch Me If You Can' moment during this part of the game (see that trophy) before you finish here.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A combat-heavy story mission: stock up on snacks and armour first. Unmissable once finished.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. The story alone is not enough: you also need the collectibles, activities, stranger strands and property content tracked in Stages 2-4. Use the game's own 100% checklist alongside this tracker and mop up by category, not by map order.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt jumps and stunt events across Leonida. They are marked on the map once discovered; clear them region by region whenever you pass one rather than grinding them all at the end. A fast bike makes most ramps trivial, and failed attempts can be retried instantly.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity once: races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, meditation spots, drone races and the rest. You only need to start each type, not win it, so spend one free-roam session visiting one of each icon on the map.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge. Learn each weapon's recoil pattern and go for headshot chains to build the multiplier; accuracy bonuses matter more than raw speed. Challenges can be replayed freely, so practise the hardest weapon class last when your stats are maxed.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. Finishing is not enough, you must place first, so learn each course with a practice run, then race it cleanly; clipping a gate cleanly beats raw speed. Do these while your drone skills are fresh from any story drone sections.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races (repeats of the same race do not add to the count). Work through the race icons on the map one by one and track which you have won here; bring a tuned car in its class and use slipstream on straights rather than fighting in corners.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Upgrade your rod and bait first, then accept Cal's challenge at the fishing spots; keep steady tension on the line and reel only when the fish stops fighting, the same rhythm as the story fishing mission taught.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game from start to finish at an arcade cabinet. Pick the shortest game on the cabinet menu; you need a completion, not a high score, so this is a five-minute trophy once you find an arcade.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand: complete every mission Andy gives you, in order, until his final mission appears, then complete that too. Stranger strands unlock as you progress the story, so check the map for his icon after each chapter.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand through to his final mission. Keep returning to his marker whenever a new one appears; the trophy pops on the final mission's completion screen.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand through to his final mission. Billy's jobs are driving-focused, so bring a reliable car; complete the whole chain and the trophy unlocks at the end of the last job.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. A strand means the whole chain for one character, not a single job: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (trophies 22-27) already cover five, so finish three more strands from the remaining strangers on the map.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand through to his final mission. His chain unlocks progressively; if his marker disappears, progress the story or another strand and it will return.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand through to his final mission. Complete each job as it appears and the trophy unlocks when the strand's finale is done.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. Spots are scenic viewpoints scattered statewide; they are quick to use once found, so tag them as you explore and sweep the map region by region. The in-game checklist shows how many remain.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret: accept Bret's hunting request, track the named unique animal using the clues he gives, and bring it down cleanly. Unique animals spawn in one specific habitat, so hunt at the time of day Bret mentions and use a scoped rifle.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across the map in shops, bars and landmarks; a set only counts when every card in it is found. Follow the set list in the pause menu, sweep one set at a time, and check behind counters and on rooftops, the set pieces' favourite hiding places.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use a WAiNK photo point at 100 different locations. These marked viewpoints are spread over the whole state; grab every one you pass during other tasks and the count climbs steadily. The last few are best hunted with the map filtered to incomplete collectibles.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges from the challenges menu (daily-style feats: distances, stunt scores, combat feats and the like). Pin several at once so they progress together while you do other roadmap stages, and swap out any that stall.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the stars and escape completely with the partner still with you. Commit crimes together in a fast car, then break line of sight and hide in alleys or a spray shop until the search ends; splitting up voids it, so stay in one vehicle.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops one after another with your partner, keeping a Wanted Level the whole time between the first robbery and escaping the third. Plan a route of three close shops beforehand, use one getaway car, and never let the wanted stars fully clear until the third till is emptied.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles: getting into a new model for the first time registers it. Visit each district and the airport, marina and countryside for their distinct traffic, and check parking lots at night for rare spawns. Your registered list in the Scooter Bros app shows what you already have.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single Combat Focus activation. Set it up deliberately: find a group of at least five enemies (a gang operation or a police standoff), weaken none of them, activate Combat Focus at full charge and chain headshots. If a charge ends at four, reload the encounter rather than wasting the setup.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (the airport): during the airport part of the story, take a plane and take off without clearance instead of following the scripted route. Treat as missable: the description points at a one-off story set piece, so do it when you are first at the airport in the story and keep a manual save from before the VCIA mission.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The cryptic one: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' means spending time in a Rhino tank until the trophy pops. Steal a Rhino from the military presence or buy one if available, then drive it around causing mayhem; the trophy is tied to using the tank, so stay in it rather than hopping out.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected: no alarm, no witnesses calling it in. Go at night, wear a mask, disable the alarm panel first, keep the staff controlled quietly and leave before any patrol passes. If detection triggers, reload and retry rather than escaping, since an escape still counts as detected.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape the police each time. Vault robberies become available as free-roam crimes; bring your partner, a drilled plan and a fast car stored nearby. Each vault only counts once you have fully lost the Wanted Level after it.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armoured truck and escape. Trucks follow set routes; ambush one in a tunnel or side street to limit police angles, blow the rear doors, grab the cash and switch cars once to drop the heat. One successful truck is all it takes.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: uncover every region of the map. The fog clears as you travel, so the reliable method is a full coastal loop plus the inland towns by car, finished with a flight over any stubborn patches. Check the map for grey areas before calling it done.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in the game. Every gang runs fronts (chop shops, stash houses, labs) marked once scouted; you need one operation per gang, not all of them. The pause-menu gang page shows which gangs you have already hit.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: buy or accept a cocktail at the Ocean Beach spot with the ocean view and drink it there. Treat as potentially missable: it sounds tied to a relaxed story moment on the beach, so try it the first time the story takes you to Ocean Beach, and again in free roam if it does not pop.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom through its glass front, in a car, 'in classic style'. Treat as missable: this reads as a one-off story set piece, so when a mission puts you inside a showroom, drive straight out through the windows instead of using the door, and keep a save from before that mission.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Do the follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: complete a bowling game there with proper follow-through form, at that specific alley. Treat as potentially missable until confirmed in free roam: visit the alley as soon as you can reach it, and if a story mission takes you there first, bowl when it does.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description ('A partnership with mass appeal') points at a partner-based milestone: keep doing partner activities together (robberies, races, escapes) with your partner and this unlocks as your partnership content accumulates. If you have done trophies 33 and 34 and this has not popped, keep clearing partner jobs from the map.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A choice trophy: 'Choices made (for better or worse)' unlocks from a decision the story asks you to make. Treat as missable: major choices are one-per-playthrough, so keep a manual save before big story decisions from Chapter 3 onward; if the trophy does not pop at a choice, reload and take the other branch to test it.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' points at failing something once and succeeding on the retry: the natural reading is a mission or challenge failed and then completed. If it has not popped during normal play, deliberately fail a short replayable mission near its end, then complete it on the immediate retry.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The UFO trophy: 'What the hell just happened?' is the game's hidden alien encounter. Look for the strange lights event at night in the remote swamp/mountain areas late in a playthrough; these encounters usually need late-game completion and a specific night-time location, so hunt it during Stage 5 cleanup and be ready to simply witness the event.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock people down with a melee drive-by at the bowling alley area ('Bowl 'em over'): drive past a group of pedestrians and swing a melee weapon from the vehicle so several go down in one pass. Line up a group on the alley's frontage, approach slowly enough to connect, and repeat passes until it pops.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 in total by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies (vaults, trucks, operations); hand them to a laundering contact rather than spending them raw. This is cumulative, so it completes naturally if you do the Stage 4 crime trophies first and always launder what they pay.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops: clothes, weapons, vehicle mods, food, everything counts. Cumulative across the whole playthrough; if you are short late, vehicle customisation on a few owned cars burns the remainder quickly.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the market. Garages appear for sale as you progress; this needs serious cash, so do it after the Stage 4 money trophies. The property page in the pause menu lists what you own; buy the cheapest missing ones first to confirm the count is moving.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app: when you find a vehicle you want to keep, use the app registration option on it. Any 10 distinct vehicles count; register story-given and purchased vehicles first, then fill the rest with street finds (this pairs naturally with 'Whip It Good').
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide
